title: What my Guru spec forgot: 31/31 checks passed, 30 gaps found #shorts
description:
Claude built a Guru alternative, an internal knowledge base that grades its own answers, from one written spec: all 31 acceptance checks passed, but my spec never said what a card looks like when its review is due soon, or whether the last admin could be deactivated. Those were 2 of 30 spec gaps, and all 30 are now fixed.

Full build test (2:46): https://youtu.be/c0GKCgOTBgo
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/knowledge-base
Guru pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/guru

Not tested: production sign-in, real email delivery, a real Slack workspace, the hourly job on a real scheduler, and hosting.

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
